capabilities: Insert dates, times, tasks, callouts, tables, code blocks and links at the cursor
Convert selected text with selection-aware actions such as highlighting or converting to a task
Create custom Markdown actions from templates with variables
Chain actions into sequential workflows with a basic editor
Import and export actions and workflows as JSON packages
extras: Local-only with no account, telemetry or AI integration. Optional local calendar is disabled by default; the README is inconsistent about ICS support (one section says ICS import/export is supported, the features list says it is not included yet). Installation guide includes manual and from-source options for before directory acceptance.
problem: Obsidian has no single searchable menu for quickly inserting common Markdown snippets and actions at the cursor, or for building reusable custom insert actions.
summary: Quick Insert menu that inserts dates, tasks, callouts, code blocks and custom Markdown actions via a searchable modal, slash menu or hotkey.
